review_evidence: README identifies the project as the Lean Language Reference built in Verso, with example code typechecked to keep prose documentation current.
Manual files contain pedagogical examples and deliberately illustrative axioms/results (for example false_is_true and two_eq_five in Manual/Axioms.lean) embedded in language documentation.
The project documents Lean syntax, commands, elaboration and runtime behavior; treating its 247 documentation modules as primary theorem search materially pollutes formalization results.
